name: Reliability, contract, and corpus reconciliation hardening
principles: Public APIs must return approved public-safe data only.
Full corpus import must pass reconciliation before release promotion.
Main-site delivery must be contract-tested after every deployment.
Every export artifact must have SHA-256, ETag and release channel metadata.
Admin permission grants must be scoped and auditable.

runtime_checks.description: OpenAPI path count and version must match v15 contract.
Latest public payload snapshot exists and has a stable ETag.
Full corpus candidate cannot promote until reconciliation passes.
Main-site bootstrap/search/vocabulary/delta endpoints pass contract tests.
No expired or global admin grants without reason.
